name: 再现天涯（08年修改版本）
group_note: same 再现天涯 game as 138 (zxty), a 2008 modified re-release -- different master.lpc content, no exact hash match but same title/lineage; finished an interrupted conversion; reimplemented efun::tail() (§6.2); boots clean. Full WASM pass: added loopback-allow to band.lpc (this lineage bans anything that doesn't parse as a strict 4-part dotted-quad); fixed the same euid-reset-by-stray-seteuid(getuid()) bug in logind.lpc (create()/make_body()); fixed check_legal_name()'s stale GBK byte-length bounds and dropped the i%2==0 byte-pairing gate; fixed named.lpc's invalid_new_name() single-character-name rejection and its byte-stepping near-duplicate-name sliding window (rewritten to step by character, same bug and same fix as nt1's named.lpc -- this lineage shares the named.lpc/registration-room design with the NT/nitan family, not just jym); guarded securityd.lpc's get_status() defensively (mapp/arrayp checks, no reentrancy actually observed but cheap insurance). Admin seeded via the plain-text /adm/etc/wizlist file (this lineage's securityd.lpc reads it directly every boot, no save-file involved). Registration through world-entry, look/score/quit (quit correctly triggers this lineage's own 30-minute-anti-abuse confirmation prompt, not a bug), and admin recognition ("您目前权限：(admin)") all cleanly verified.
